text:
maya: Ok team — quick sync. We're launching the Takeoff playbook next Tue. Need final checklist for: launch posts, webinar promo, free-credit drip, prompt templates bundle, and inbound routing.
noah: timeline?
maya: marketing post Tue AM, webinar Wed noon PT, credit drip starts Wed evening for attendees.
sam: for benchmarking: what's our primary KPI? activation (first 5 requests) or D7 retention?
olivia: primary = activation (first 5 requests within 24h) + secondary = D7 return rate. want to compare to last cohort baseline (activation 22%).
rachel: creative note: keep launch posts short, show 2x prompt examples, CTA -> 'Try with free $20 credits' link.
noah: routing question — what counts as high-fit inbound that should go to SDRs vs self-serve?
maya: high-fit = company size >50, pressing security/regulatory in form, or request for dedicated/private. route those to sales. everything else: self-serve + nurture drip with credit boosters.
ops-bot: reminder: set routing rule = {"if": "company_size>50 or prod_interest contains 'private' or 'sla'", "route_to": "sales-sdr"} (deployed to routing-service-2)
sam: can we add a small promptpack to the credit landing to drive activation? 3 ready-to-use templates: customer-support, summarizer, code-assistant.
olivia: yes. UX copy for landing: 'Start building in minutes — pick a template, paste, and run. Credits included.'
rachel: webinar script outline: 10 min product demo, 15 min prompt walkthrough, 15 min Q&A + live signup incentive (extra $10 credits for attendees who complete first 3 requests).
maya: pricing ops — confirm credit caps. legal/finance: can we auto-issue extra $10 credits?
noah: finance ok with promo up to 5k total promo credits; add usage cap per account = $50.
maya: ops to set per-account cap and auto-issue flow for webinar attendees. @ops-bot can you create the promo bucket and webhook for attendee claim?
ops-bot: creating promo bucket 'takeoff-webinar-2026' and webhook endpoint /promo/claim. ETA 4h.
sam: quick ask — how are we measuring prompt-template impact? want an eval where we track completion -> useful actions.
olivia: add an event 'template_run' with metadata: template_id, tokens_used, success=true/false. we'll hook into experiment dashboard.
maya: action items: 1) noah — set routing rules and SDR handoff playbook (due EOD today). 2) ops-bot / ops — create promo bucket + webhook (ETA 4h). 3) rachel + olivia — landing & post copy + webinar script (first draft by EOD). 4) sam — set up eval suite & baseline comparison (tomorrow morning).
noah: noted, will push routing rules and update the sales playbook doc.
rachel: will draft copy now, ping for quick review.
sam: I'll seed the promptpack and wire template_run events to analytics.
maya: perfect. small checklist: social posts (TL;DR + 2 prompts), blog post with benchmark narrative, webinar signup page, promo bucket, routing rules, prompt templates, dashboard widgets. anything missing?
olivia: test signup flow end-to-end — include claim webhook and auto-credit issuance in QA.
maya: good call. last thing: messaging variants A/B test on the landing header: "Launch with templates + $20 free" vs "Try Redwood inference with instant templates" — we'll run 50/50.
noah: can we also set a tiny experiment to route 10% of inbound to SDRs even if low-fit, to measure conversion delta?
maya: yes, create an experiment flag: sdr_probe = 10%. monitor cost vs conv uplift.
ops-bot: experiment flag created: sdr_probe=10%.
maya: thanks all — I'll post a short recap and ticket links. :rocket:
